interpretations: Return the 10 accounts with the most orders, subtracting the average order count across all accounts with at least one order. Show each account’s ID, its branch district’s region, its order count, and the unrounded difference, ordered by largest difference first
Include every account tied at the 10th rank by order count, even if that produces more than 10 accounts; calculate the difference from the same global average
Include every account whose order count is among the 10 highest distinct order counts, even if that produces more than 10 accounts; calculate the difference from the same global average
Include only accounts whose order count is strictly above the average across accounts with orders; return up to 10 accounts, ordered by the unrounded difference from largest to smallest
queries:
WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT
    oc.account_id,
    d.A3 AS region,
    oc.order_count,
    oc.order_count - (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM order_counts) AS difference
FROM order_counts AS oc
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = oc.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
ORDER BY difference DESC, oc.account_id
LIMIT 10

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN `order` AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           order_count,
           order_count - AVG(order_count) OVER () AS difference_from_global_average,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_rank
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT account_id, order_count, difference_from_global_average
FROM ranked
WHERE order_rank <= 10
ORDER BY order_count DESC, account_id

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        order_count,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS count_rank,
        AVG(order_count) OVER () AS global_average
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    order_count,
    order_count - global_average AS difference_from_average
FROM ranked
WHERE count_rank <= 10
ORDER BY order_count DESC, account_id

WITH order_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
average_count AS (
    SELECT AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count
    FROM order_counts
)
SELECT
    oc.account_id,
    oc.order_count,
    oc.order_count - ac.avg_order_count AS difference
FROM order_counts AS oc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
WHERE oc.order_count > ac.avg_order_count
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
